segments.normalizedSource: ```objc - (void)relinquishPresentedItemToWriter:(void (^)(void (^reacquirer)(void))) writer { // Prepare for another object to write to the file. self.fileIsWritable = NO; // Now let the writer know that it can have the file. // But pass a reacquisition block so that this object // can update itself when the writer is done. writer(^{ self.fileIsWritable = YES; }); } ```
